title: Skins
description: Putting three skins on the greeter and renaming one

console: animus create greeter name=Greeter world=world x=-2.5 y=64 z=-9.5
animus create trader type=minecraft:llama name=Trader world=world x=4.5 y=64 z=-9.5

beats.result: Skin lists the town's skins with who wears each, then My skin, Player name and Default

beats.note: the top item names the greeter and the skin it wears now

beats.result: your own skin joins the list, worn by the greeter

beats.note: the server looks the skin up on Mojang's servers

beats.result: the skin's details: Wear it, Rename and Delete

beats.note: the renamed skin, still worn by the greeter

closing: The greeter wore Notch, your skin and Searge's, now named Mojang dev
